messages:
Maya: launching a small-pricing micro-experiment next Wed 08:00 PT. This is opt-in for customers on self-serve only; enterprise committed deals get auto-grandfather unless they request otherwise. link: https://g.co/redwood/pricing-micro (gdoc).
Elaine: confirmed. need cohort CSV + opt-in list by Tue EOD. Also want a short rollback path for any invoice anomalies.
Sam: metric priorities? revenue drift or NRR changes?
Maya: primary = no invoice format changes. secondary = <2% revenue delta in week 1 for opt-in group. tertiary = signal on conversion.
Raj: billing asks: provide billing_account_id and a reconciliation key. I'll run a delta job post-cutover. small sample query:
```
SELECT billing_account_id, period, old_tokens, new_tokens, (new_tokens-old_tokens) as token_delta
FROM billing_delta
WHERE period = '2026-10'
```

Olivia: Legal: include explicit sentence: "Committed agreements with signed addenda are excluded from automatic pricing changes unless the customer opts in." I'll draft notice.
Elaine: ops: canary 30 accounts (10 L / 10 M / 10 H). Tag with `micro_exp_canary=true`. Marco can you own tagging?
Sam: growth will only email opt-in cohort after they click accept. we need final copy Tue 11:00 PT. @Olivia review please.
Maya: billing-bot: File uploaded: pricing-micro-cohort.csv (uploaded by Maya) :file_folder:
Maya: sample row in doc:
```csv
billing_account_id,opt_in,usage_bucket
acct_7001,true,low
acct_7002,false,high
```

Raj: blocker: consolidated billing parents appear in opt-in list. please exclude parent accounts or provide mapping. I'll DM a sample mapping.
Elaine: decision: auto-grandfather = committed deals with addenda signed before 2025-12-01 until 2027-12-31; micro-experiment is opt-in self-serve for eligible accounts; canary = 30 accounts.
Maya: I'll lock cohort Tue 5pm and post final list. drop any last exceptions in the sheet. :thumbsup:
Sam: ack :eyes:
